exposure: time interval between previous and current delivery
outcome: successful vaginal birth after cesarean delivery (VBAC)
cohort: 302 women with singleton pregnancy, at or beyond 37 weeks' gestation, admitted with spontaneous PROM, with one previous cesarean delivery
finding: The duration of PROM-to-delivery time was the only significant factor associated with successful VBAC in women with spontaneous PROM at term.
mod_finding: Women with spontaneous pre-labor PROM and previous cesarean delivery have high success rates of vaginal birth after cesarean delivery (VBAC).
